title: Cycle Detection
definition: Floyd's Tortoise and Hare algorithm uses two pointers moving at different speeds to detect if a Linked List loops infinitely. It detects a cycle in O(N) time and O(1) space.
simpleExplanation: If two runners are on a circular track and one runs twice as fast as the other, the fast runner will eventually lap the slow runner.

answers.question: **Basic:** Linked List Cycle (Floyd's Tortoise & Hare)
**Advanced:** Find Cycle Starting Node
